messages:
Mira Shah: Corvus Health wants to onboard a tuned variant `vicuna-13b-corvus` for a HIPAA-adjacent POC. They will share a private HF link after DPA. Main asks: model variant compatibility, latency SLO p95 <140ms for short chats, and a Dedicated pricing ballpark. SE/infra can you advise?
Leo Tan: First ask repo type (full checkpoint vs adapter) and tokenizer diffs. Those are the top blockers.
Mira Shah: They said full checkpoint + ~18MB LoRA on top of our base vicuna-13b. Tokenizer mostly unchanged, per buyer.
Diane Park: Runtime note: vicuna-13b generally supports NF4 on H100 with our kernels. Recommend pilot config: prefer H100, max_seq 512, max_batch 8, KV warmers on. Fallback: vicuna-13b-corvus-8bit for A100 regions. We'll run a short nf4 vs 8-bit quality A/B on our clinical-regress set before approving.
Diane Park: Suggested smoke variant config: 
variant: vicuna-13b-corvus-nf4; hw: h100; quant: nf4; max_batch: 8; max_seq: 512
Samir Khan: Pricing ballpark: hosted private pilot (on-demand H100) ~ $7k/mo. Dedicated reserved baseline for p95 <140ms at modest scale: 2x H100 ~ $23k/mo. Add 10-15% for HA/burst. If they insist on A100-only expect +20% premium.
Samir Khan: For PHI we require Private (VPC) or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS/HSM plus signed DPA and SOC2 evidence.
tickets-bot: ticket #INF-8300 created: "Corvus vicuna-13b-corvus onboarding + nf4 compatibility" assigned to Leo, Diane, Samir.
Mira Shah: Action items: (1) I will collect HF link, expected QPS, sample prompts (2) Leo to run tokenizer sanity + adapter verify (3) Diane to spin a H100 smoke profile and run latency tests (4) Samir to prep pricing note and compliance checklist. ETA EOD+1.
